:::{#def-ball}
#### Open ball

Let $\vx \in \reals^p$ and $r > 0$.
The **open ball**
[@wikipedia_ball_mathematics]
of radius $r$ around $\vx$,
written $\ball{\vx}{r}$,
is the [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set)
of [points](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-real-coordinate-space) whose distance from $\vx$
(the [Euclidean norm](linear-algebra.qmd#def-euclidean-norm) of the difference)
is less than $r$:

<!-- check-ball-neighborhoods: allow: defines the ball -->
$$
\ball{\vx}{r} \eqdef \cb{\vy \in \reals^p : \norm{\vy - \vx} < r}.
$$

:::
